test_case.test_name: ED-24 independent IIO change-default and PCIe target restoration
test_case.purpose: Independently prove an approved IIO change persists and restore selected factory or project target while all PCIe routes, endpoints, links, drivers and error state match the signed topology.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/PCIe KVM operator and drained maintenance window
DEFAULT_TARGET plus separate factory/project IIO matrices
Reversible routing/bifurcation value and per-path oracle
Backup, recipe application and KVM/physical/CMOS recovery plan
test_case.test_command: For this row only, capture baseline IIO page/full topology; change one approved reversible control/group, save/reboot and prove retention plus all affected/sibling paths. Invoke firmware Load Defaults and record factory topology. If DEFAULT_TARGET=PROJECT_RECIPE, apply approved recipe and reboot. Compare final page, BDFs, identities, gen/width, affinity, drivers and AER to selected target.
test_case.expected_result: The change persists; every phase meets signed boot/path/link/driver/AER criteria; factory output is separate; final page and complete PCIe topology exactly match selected Factory Default or Project Recipe.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only against declared target with row-specific screens and per-path evidence. Factory cannot satisfy Project Recipe. Missing/moved/downgraded endpoint, driver/AER fault, wrong restoration or no-boot is FAIL. Missing target/oracle/recovery is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until target, matrices, route ownership, workload drain and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or unsupported routing/bifurcation.
Back up project state; preserve AER/SEL/kernel logs and do not reset/retrain endpoints.
Operator controls save/reboot/default/recipe/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, ED-11/ED-24 approval and platform/topology identity
Declared target, factory/project matrices and safe value/dependency map
Unique baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults, optional recipe and final screenshots
Per-phase root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint BDF, lane, gen/width, affinity and driver inventory
Backup/restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on endpoint/link/driver/AER/boot anomaly and preserve evidence. Qualified personnel restore backed-up project topology through signed recovery; do not reset/retrain devices, reuse row 2181 evidence or blindly retry.
